saber.about: Saber is the Servant Kiritsugu Emiya calls forth for the fourth war over the Holy Grail: King Arthur, the legendary ruler of Britain, who in this story is a young woman in blue and silver armour. Disciplined, honourable and stern, she fights with a sword hidden inside a whirl of invisible wind. Kiritsugu barely speaks to her and has his wife, Irisviel, act as her public Master while he pursues the war by ruthless methods Saber finds dishonourable, so much of her early story is a clash of values with her own side. Among rival Servants she quickly earns respect, especially from Lancer, with whom she shares an early duel between knights.

jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.name: Sukuna
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.role: The King of Curses; ancient sorcerer whose twenty severed fingers survive as cursed objects
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.notes: Full name Ryomen Sukuna. Relatives and later events left out to avoid spoilers.
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.abilities: The King of Curses, sealed in Yuji Itadori's body after Yuji eats one of his fingers; he regenerates and slices targets apart with invisible slashes.

fate.detail: Yuji defeats him in the Shinjuku Showdown; he accepts his defeat and his soul fades away in manga chapter 268 (2024). The anime has not reached this yet.

jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.about: Sukuna, known as the King of Curses, was a fearsome sorcerer from the golden age of jujutsu a thousand years ago whom no one could defeat. His remains survive as twenty severed fingers, cursed objects so powerful that they cannot be destroyed, and sorcerers have kept them sealed away for centuries. When high school student Yuji Itadori swallows one to save his friends from a curse, Sukuna awakens inside Yuji's body and shares it with him, sometimes speaking through a mouth that opens on Yuji's cheek or hand. Arrogant, cruel and easily amused, he regards humans as playthings and waits for his chance to seize control. Yuji's agreement to consume the remaining fingers drives the plot.

rei-ayanami.name: Rei Ayanami
rei-ayanami.notes: Neon Genesis Evangelion is an original anime, so source is null; Wikipedia notes the Sadamoto manga, published first, introduces her in chapter 2 ("Reunion"). Her background is left out to avoid spoilers.
rei-ayanami.abilities: The First Child, a quiet, emotionless pilot of Evangelion Unit-00 who follows Commander Ikari's orders without question.

fate.detail: In episode 23, "Rei III", she self-destructs Unit-00 to destroy the Angel Armisael and save Shinji; a new clone, the third Rei, replaces her.

rei-ayanami.about: Known as the First Child, Rei Ayanami was the first pilot chosen for Evangelion Unit-00, and when Shinji Ikari first sees her she is being wheeled in on a stretcher, bandaged and badly hurt, as a reason for him to pilot instead. Rei is quiet, pale and almost expressionless, answers questions as briefly as possible, and follows the orders of Nerv commander Gendo Ikari, Shinji's distant father, without hesitation. She lives alone in a bare apartment and seems uninterested in ordinary life, which puzzles Shinji. Over the early Angel battles he slowly gets glimpses of the person beneath her calm. With her pale blue hair, red eyes and stillness, she is one of the most recognisable figures in the series.

johan-liebert.name: Johan Liebert
johan-liebert.role: Boy whose life Dr. Kenzo Tenma saves after he is shot in the head
johan-liebert.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by the Wikipedia episode summary. Chapter 1 rests on the Wikipedia character list (Tenma saves him at the start of the story); no Monster fan wiki could be reached, and the chapter number was not confirmed by a second source. Everything else left out to avoid spoilers.
johan-liebert.abilities: Extraordinarily intelligent and charismatic, he wins people's trust and manipulates them into doing what he wants.

fate.detail: Johan is shot in the head in Ruhenheim during the finale but survives; the final episode (74) ends with his hospital bed empty.

johan-liebert.about: Johan Liebert is a young boy brought into a Düsseldorf hospital in 1986 with a gunshot wound to the head, following a shooting at the home of his family, defectors from East Germany. His twin sister is found at the scene in shock. Dr. Kenzo Tenma, a Japanese neurosurgeon, defies his director's order to operate on the town's mayor instead and saves the boy, a decision that wrecks his own career prospects at the hospital. Soon afterwards, the twins vanish without a trace. Years later, the consequences of that night return to upend Tenma's life, and the question of who Johan really is, and what happened in his past, becomes the central mystery of the series.

misato-katsuragi.name: Misato Katsuragi
misato-katsuragi.role: Nerv officer who takes Shinji Ikari in as her ward
misato-katsuragi.notes: Neon Genesis Evangelion is an original anime, so source is null; Wikipedia notes she also opens chapter 1 ("Angel Attack") of the Sadamoto manga, published first. Her background is left out to avoid spoilers.
misato-katsuragi.abilities: NERV's Operations Director, a bold tactical commander who plans the battles against the Angels; at home she is Shinji's messy, beer-loving guardian.

fate.detail: In The End of Evangelion (1997), she is shot while getting Shinji to Unit-01, gives him her cross pendant and dies in an explosion.

misato-katsuragi.about: Misato Katsuragi runs operations at Nerv, the agency fighting the Angels, and the officer who picks up fourteen-year-old Shinji Ikari at the station as the first Angel attacks Tokyo-3. At work she is decisive and bold, planning each battle and directing the Eva pilots in the field. At home she is a cheerful mess: she lives on instant food and beer, keeps a warm-water penguin named Pen Pen, and leaves her apartment cluttered. Unwilling to let Shinji live alone, she takes him in as her ward. Misato's breezy humour hides how much she carries, and her uneasy role as both commander and guardian shapes much of Shinji's story.

yami-sukehiro.name: Yami Sukehiro
yami-sukehiro.role: Captain of the Black Bulls, the Magic Knights squad Asta joins
yami-sukehiro.notes: Chapter 2 ("The Magic Knights Entrance Exam") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 4 rests on the Black Clover Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 4 does not name him. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
yami-sukehiro.abilities: Captain of the Black Bulls, a swordsman whose Dark Magic lets his katana cut through almost anything, and who can sense opponents' movements through 'ki'.

fate.detail: Yami is alive in the anime and in the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

yami-sukehiro.about: Yami Sukehiro is the captain of the Black Bulls, the Clover Kingdom's least respected Magic Knight squad, and a foreigner who arrived from the distant Land of the Sun. Big, scruffy and usually smoking, he is intimidating, short-tempered and quick to threaten his own subordinates, yet he stands by them when it counts. At the Magic Knights entrance exam, he is the only captain willing to take on Asta, the boy with no magic whom nobody else wants, after testing his nerve. He fights with a katana infused with Dark Magic that can cut through almost anything and senses opponents through ki. His motto: surpass your limits, right here, right now.

shouya-ishida.name: Shouya Ishida
shouya-ishida.role: Protagonist; former elementary school bully who seeks to reconnect with Shouko Nishimiya, a deaf girl he tormented
shouya-ishida.notes: There is no TV anime: Koe no Katachi (A Silent Voice) is a 2016 film, so episode is null. Chapter 1 per the Koe no Katachi Wiki; Wikipedia confirms he is on the volume 1 cover and opens the story. Mother named in the wiki infobox and the Wikipedia character list.
shouya-ishida.abilities: As a child, a reckless, thrill-seeking bully; as a teenager, a withdrawn loner who learns sign language to communicate with Shouko.

fate.detail: Shouya survives; he falls into a river saving Shouko and is in a coma for a while, but recovers.

shouya-ishida.about: Shouya Ishida is the protagonist of A Silent Voice. As a restless sixth-grader who is afraid of being bored, he picks on Shouko Nishimiya, a deaf girl who transfers into his class, mocking her and repeatedly destroying her hearing aids. When the school finally confronts the bullying, his classmates turn on him and he becomes the outcast instead. By high school he is a withdrawn loner who cannot look people in the face and imagines a cross over each of them. He has quietly learned sign language, and he seeks Shouko out to return a notebook and try to apologise. The film follows his slow, painful attempt to make amends and to forgive himself.

sakuta-azusagawa.name: Sakuta Azusagawa
sakuta-azusagawa.role: Protagonist; high school student who looks into cases of Adolescence Syndrome after meeting Mai Sakurajima

debut.anime: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai
debut.episodeTitle: My Senpai is a Bunny Girl

sakuta-azusagawa.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Rascal Does Not Dream Wiki; Wikipedia's synopsis of the first volume centres on him. Other family left out to avoid spoilers.
sakuta-azusagawa.abilities: A deadpan, blunt-spoken high schooler who helps girls affected by 'Adolescence Syndrome', starting with Mai Sakurajima.

fate.detail: In the film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl (2019) there is a timeline in which he is killed in a traffic accident, but Shoko changes the past so that he survives; he is alive in the ongoing series.

sakuta-azusagawa.about: Sakuta Azusagawa is a second-year at Minegahara High School in Fujisawa who does not own a mobile phone and has an unflattering reputation, thanks to a rumour that he once put three classmates in hospital. He brushes off the gossip with a deadpan, sarcastic manner and lives with his younger sister, Kaede, who rarely leaves the house. One day in the library he spots Mai Sakurajima, a famous actress a year above him, wandering around in a bunny-girl costume that nobody else seems able to see. Recognising it as a case of Adolescence Syndrome, a supernatural phenomenon dismissed as an internet rumour, he sets out to help her. Blunt, kind and observant, he keeps getting involved.

yuu-nishinoya.name: Yuu Nishinoya
yuu-nishinoya.role: Second-year libero of Karasuno High's volleyball team
yuu-nishinoya.notes: Episode 7 and chapter 15 ("Chemical Reaction", a brief appearance; he appears properly in chapter 16, "Another Prodigy") rest on the Haikyu!! Wiki. The Wikipedia summary of episode 7 mentions Karasuno's returning libero without naming him; episode 8 is the first to name him.
yuu-nishinoya.abilities: Karasuno's libero, a short but fearless defensive specialist with lightning reflexes who can receive almost any spike.

fate.detail: Nobody dies in Haikyu!!; after the timeskip Nishinoya has quit volleyball to travel the world (he is in Italy during the final arc).

yuu-nishinoya.about: Yu Nishinoya is Karasuno's second-year libero, a defensive specialist who is the shortest player on the team and also its loudest. He has spiky hair with a bleached streak, a short temper and boundless confidence, and he and his friend Ryunosuke Tanaka compete to impress the team's manager, Kiyoko Shimizu. He won a best-libero award in middle school, and his reflexes let him dig out spikes nobody else could reach. When the story begins he has been suspended from club activities after a run-in with the vice principal, and he wants Asahi, the team's ace, to return as well. He likes giving his receives flashy names, such as his Rolling Thunder.

chainsaw-man-reze.name: Reze
chainsaw-man-reze.role: Girl working at a cafe who befriends Denji
chainsaw-man-reze.notes: Chapter 40 is confirmed by both sources. Her episode 12 appearance is a short scene at the end of the TV series per the Chainsaw Man Wiki (AniList also lists her in the TV series); Wikipedia's episode summary does not name her. Her main anime appearance is the 2025 film Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc. Affiliations left out to avoid spoilers.
chainsaw-man-reze.abilities: Introduced as a friendly cafe worker Denji meets while sheltering from the rain; she turns out to be far more dangerous than she looks.

fate.detail: At the end of the Reze arc (manga chapter 52; Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc, 2025) she is mortally wounded by the Angel Devil under Makima's orders, but she later reappears under Makima's control and is freed after Makima's death; her whereabouts are unknown.

chainsaw-man-reze.about: Reze is a young woman Denji meets by chance, who soon invites him to the quiet café where she works. Friendly, playful and openly affectionate from the start, she laughs at his jokes, shows an immediate interest in him and offers to teach him things he never had the chance to learn. Starved of ordinary kindness, Denji falls for her almost at once and starts to question his feelings for his boss, Makima. Their late-night outings together, and the easy closeness that grows between them, form the heart of the story's Reze arc.

nami.name: Nami
nami.role: Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates and a skilled thief

debut.episodeTitle: I'm Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

nami.notes: Chapter 8 ("Nami") is confirmed by both sources; she is also on the chapter 1 cover. Episode 1 rests on the One Piece Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 does not name her. Arcs listed are the East Blue arcs. Her earlier affiliation is left out to avoid spoilers.
nami.abilities: The Straw Hats' navigator, who can read the weather and sea with uncanny skill, draws maps and is a talented thief; she fights with a staff.

fate.detail: Nami is alive in the anime and the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

nami.about: Nami is a young thief who makes a living stealing from pirates, and a gifted navigator who can sense changes in the weather before anyone else and draws her own sea charts. Luffy meets her in Orange Town while both of them are tangling with the clown pirate Buggy, and she agrees to team up with him for profit, insisting that she hates pirates and will never be one. Nami is sharp, practical and openly greedy, haggles over everything, and keeps a careful eye on the crew's money. She also has a temper and hits Luffy and the others when they act foolishly. Why she wants so much money is a mystery she keeps to herself.

gyro-zeppeli.name: Gyro Zeppeli
gyro-zeppeli.role: Neapolitan rider in the Steel Ball Run race who fights with spinning steel balls

debut.anime: Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken

gyro-zeppeli.notes: Episode 1 (the "1st Stage", released on Netflix on March 19, 2026) is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 1 of Steel Ball Run and his father rest on the JoJo Wiki.
gyro-zeppeli.abilities: A Neapolitan executioner and master of the Spin, which channels rotational energy through steel balls, backed by deep medical knowledge.

fate.detail: Funny Valentine kills him during their battle near the end of the race, after D4C Love Train turns a wound back on him (Steel Ball Run manga).

gyro-zeppeli.about: Gyro Zeppeli is a rider from the Kingdom of Naples who enters the Steel Ball Run, a horse race across North America, with a pair of steel balls hanging from his belt. Cocky, flamboyant and fond of terrible jokes, he wears a broad-brimmed hat and has gold teeth spelling out 'GO! GO! ZEPPELI'. His family serve as Naples' official executioners and also practise medicine, and he has mastered their secret technique, the Spin, which channels rotational force through the steel balls to strike opponents or treat injuries. When the paralysed former jockey Johnny Joestar touches one of the spinning balls and briefly stands, Johnny joins the race to learn its secret, and the two form an uneasy partnership.

ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.name: Ray
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.role: One of the three eldest and smartest orphans at Grace Field House, with Emma and Norman
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.notes: Chapter 1 ("Grace Field House") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 1 rests on the Promised Neverland Wiki episode page; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 names only Emma and Norman. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.abilities: A genius orphan at Grace Field House and Norman's equal in intelligence, an avid reader who is skilled at planning and secretly knows the truth about the farm.

fate.detail: Ray survives the series and is alive at the end of the manga (2020) and the anime's second season (2021); the author has said Ray was originally going to die.

ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.about: Ray is one of the three eleven-year-olds at Grace Field House, an orphanage where the children wear numbers and take daily tests, and he regularly matches Emma and Norman for top scores. He has dark hair falling over one eye, prefers reading to the group's games of tag, and has a sarcastic, guarded manner. When Emma and Norman discover the horrifying truth about where the 'adopted' children really go, Ray joins their plan to escape and becomes its coldest strategist, ready to argue for options the others find unthinkable. He treats the escape as a puzzle to be solved, and his cold logic balances Emma's idealism and Norman's caution.

jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.name: Toge Inumaki
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.role: Second-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who uses Cursed Speech and talks only in rice ball ingredients
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.notes: Episode 5 is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 10 rests on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki; both sources agree he first appeared in the prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0.
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.abilities: A semi-Grade 1 sorcerer who uses Cursed Speech to make people obey spoken commands, so he talks only in rice-ball fillings to avoid hurting anyone.

fate.detail: He loses his left arm to Sukuna in the Shibuya Incident but survives and is alive at the series' end (manga chapter 271, 2024).

jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.about: Toge Inumaki, an upperclassman one year above Yuji Itadori's group at Tokyo Jujutsu High, is an heir of the Inumaki clan, whose Cursed Speech technique turns his spoken commands into orders that people and curses cannot resist. Because a careless remark could hurt anyone nearby, he limits everyday conversation to the names of rice-ball fillings, which his classmates have learned to interpret. He is ranked as a semi-Grade 1 sorcerer despite being only a second-year. Quiet-looking but friendly and playful, he trains alongside fellow second-years Maki Zenin and Panda and quickly gets on with the new first-years.
